_comment: Rdio Scanner CLI configuration. All fields are optional.
_comment_monitor: monitor: which system/talkgroup pairs to subscribe to. null = receive everything. Each entry requires 'system' (ID). 'talkgroups' is optional — omit it to receive all talkgroups in that system. Talkgroup IDs are scoped to their system, so the same ID on different systems is handled correctly.
_comment_monitorExclude: monitorExclude: system/talkgroup pairs to exclude from monitoring. Same structure as monitor. Applied after monitor — entries here are removed from whatever monitor includes. null = exclude nothing.
_comment_logLevel: logLevel: minimum log level for stderr output. Valid values: error, warn, info, debug. Can also be set via the LOG_LEVEL environment variable (config takes precedence).

plugins._comment: Object form: restrict a plugin to specific systems/talkgroups
